info.title: International Contract: OGC SensorThings Observations
info.description: Derived only from OGC SensorThings API Part 1: Sensing v1.1 (OGC 18-088), https://docs.ogc.org/is/18-088/18-088.html, sections 8.2.5 (Datastream), 8.2.7 (ObservedProperty), 8.2.8 (Observation) and 8.2.9 (FeatureOfInterest) as published. SensorThings defines its own URL scheme and OData query options; only the entity shapes and the observation-listing path are expressed here.

get.summary: List the Observations belonging to a Datastream.

EntityId.description: @iot.id: a service-generated identifier. The standard examples use integers; services may use strings.

phenomenonTime.description: The time instant or period of when the Observation happens. ISO 8601 time string or time interval string (e.g. 2010-12-23T10:20:00.00-07:00 or 2010-12-23T10:20:00.00-07:00/2010-12-23T12:20:00.00-07:00).

result.description: The estimated value of an ObservedProperty from the Observation. Its data type depends on the observationType of the Datastream (Any).

resultTime.description: The time the result of the Observation was generated (ISO 8601 time string). Null when the service could not assign one.

resultQuality.description: Describes the quality of the result. Zero-to-many DQ_Element (ISO 19157); the standard does not fix a JSON shape.

validTime.description: The time period during which the result may be used (ISO 8601 time interval string).

parameters.description: Key-value pairs showing the environmental conditions during measurement.

name.description: A label for the Thing, commonly a descriptive name.

description.description: A short description of the Thing.

name.description: A label for the Datastream, commonly a descriptive name.

observationType.description: The type of Observation (with unique result type), used by the service to encode observations (a ValueCode).

observedArea.description: Bounding box of all FeaturesOfInterest of this Datastream's Observations (GeoJSON Polygon).

phenomenonTime.description: Temporal interval of the phenomenon times of all observations in this Datastream (ISO 8601 time interval).

resultTime.description: Temporal interval of the result times of all observations in this Datastream (ISO 8601 time interval).

name.description: Full name of the unit of measurement.

symbol.description: Textual form of the unit symbol.

definition.description: URI defining the unit of measurement.

UnitOfMeasurement.description: Values SHOULD follow UCUM. When the Datastream has no unit (e.g. OM_TruthObservation), all three properties SHALL be null.

name.description: A label for the ObservedProperty, commonly a descriptive name.

definition.description: URI of the ObservedProperty. Dereferencing SHOULD return its definition.

encodingType.description: Encoding type of the feature property (a ValueCode, Table 7 of the standard).

feature.description: Detailed description of the feature; its data type is defined by encodingType.
